newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW- CEO says China deal significant.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW- CEO says China deal significant.

text.p: TRW Inc chairman and chief executive officer Joseph Gorman said Friday an agreement announced earlier for cellular telephone service in China is significant for TRW. He declined to give specific figures.
As reported, TRW is building the Odyssey satellite system through which celluar service will be provided in China.
"We hope to make a good deal of money on this deal," he said in a telephone interview. He said TRW expects to be able to reap "a return significantly above the cost of capital."
As reported, TRW and Canada's Teleglobe Inc jointly own Odyssey Telecommunications International Inc.
